contiguidade.criterio: edge adjacency (Manhattan 1) on the 2x2 grid of quadrants

amazonia_seed500_mlp_semobs_ampliacao_d1.nota_esquecimento: delta_m = final - immediate. In the EXPANSION, `imediato` is the end of the entry stage, not a converged model in that quadrant: a negative delta is expected and measures help from the following stages, NOT absence of forgetting. To compare with the chain, use `reserva_final` and `trajetoria_reserva`.

reserva_uniao.nota: mean of per-quadrant MAEs; the n-weighted one is comparable to an MAE computed over the union of nodes. The four reserves have different target variability, so the skill mean is the defensible aggregation and the MAE mean is only descriptive.
